description: This file is a plugin for CKEditor that adds color button functionalities, including color pickers for text and background colors, with color palettes and style application logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the colorbutton plugin, adding color buttons and their behaviors to the editor.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Creates and adds a color button to the editor UI with color palette and event handlers.

methods.name: renderColors
methods.description: Generates HTML for the color palette and 'more colors' option.

methods.name: isUnstylable
methods.description: Checks if an element should not be styled (contentEditable=false or data-cke-nostyle attribute).
